prediction.overall_explanation: The TransparentUpgradeableProxy contract implements the transparent proxy pattern correctly. The admin is set immutably during construction, and only the admin can call upgrade functions while all other calls are forwarded to the implementation. The contract properly prevents admin accounts from calling implementation functions directly by reverting with ProxyDeniedAdminAccess. The design follows established security patterns from OpenZeppelin and maintains the separation of upgrade rights from normal usage rights effectively.
